description: EXPR-DOMAIN, missing variant: what a domain function sees of another process's uncommitted, rolled-back and committed rows and its edit buffer. Participant b (own process) opens the file shared read-write, BeginTrans, INSERT id 1 into the empty Dtx; participant a reads DCount('*', 'Dtx') and DLookup('id', 'Dtx') at baseline and after each step: b's uncommitted insert, b's Rollback, b's BeginTrans, INSERT id 2 and CommitTrans, b's AddNew id = 50 before Update and after Update. Steps are ordered by signals. Follow-up probe (round 2) for EXPR-DOMAIN; works on a fresh writable copy of fixture r-q2-expr-sql-main. Each DAO statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
